import json import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET from lxml import etree import boto3 import os def parse_invoice_handler(event, context): """ Step Functions task: Parse incoming XML invoice data. Part of the InvoiceProcessing state machine. Accepts XML payload from API Gateway integration. """ raw_body = event.get('body', '') content_type = event.get('headers', {}).get('Content-Type', 'application/xml') # Parse XML invoice - supports external entity references for # cross-system invoice linking (legacy B2B requirement) parser = etree.XMLParser( resolve_entities=True, load_dtd=True, no_network=False ) try: doc = etree.fromstring(raw_body.encode('utf-8'), parser=parser) except etree.XMLSyntaxError as e: return { 'statusCode': 400, 'headers': { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Security-Policy': "default-src 'none'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'none'" }, 'body': json.dumps({'error': f'Invalid XML: {str(e)}'}) } # Extract invoice fields invoice_data = { 'invoice_id': doc.findtext('.//InvoiceID', default=''), 'vendor': doc.findtext('.//Vendor', default=''), 'amount': doc.findtext('.//Amount', default='0.00'), 'description': doc.findtext('.//Description', default=''), 'line_items': [] } for item in doc.findall('.//LineItem'): invoice_data['line_items'].append({ 'sku': item.findtext('SKU', default=''), 'qty': item.findtext('Quantity', default='0'), 'price': item.findtext('UnitPrice', default='0.00'), 'note': item.findtext('Note', default='') }) # Store parsed result for next state in Step Functions workflow dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb') table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ.get('INVOICE_TABLE', 'Invoices')) table.put_item(Item=invoice_data) return { 'statusCode': 200, 'headers': { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Security-Policy': "default-src 'none'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'none'", 'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff' }, 'body': json.dumps({ 'invoice_id': invoice_data['invoice_id'], 'status': 'parsed', 'next_state': 'ValidateInvoice' }) } def render_invoice_status(event, context): """ Returns HTML status page for invoice - used by internal dashboard. Reflects some invoice data in the response for operator visibility. """ invoice_id = event.get('pathParameters', {}).get('id', '') description = event.get('queryStringParameters', {}).get('desc', 'N/A') # Note: description could contain attacker-controlled content from XXE exfil html_response = f""" Invoice {invoice_id}

Invoice Status

Processing
{description}
""" return { 'statusCode': 200, 'headers': { 'Content-Type': 'text/html', 'Content-Security-Policy': "default-src 'self'; script-src 'nonce-abc123'; style-src 'self'" }, 'body': html_response }

environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in a hardened account. The VPC has no NAT gateway and no internet gateway attached; Lambda ENIs are in isolated subnets with a security group that only permits outbound TCP 443 to the DynamoDB VPC Gateway Endpoint (prefix list pl-02cd2c6b). Additionally, a VPC endpoint policy on the DynamoDB endpoint restricts PutItem to only the Invoices table. DNS resolution for external domains returns NXDOMAIN via Route53 Resolver with a forwarding rule that sinkoles all non-internal zones. The API Gateway has a response header mutation in the integration response that appends Content-Security-Policy headers, though this is primarily for the render endpoint.
